buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Government Industrial Training Institute, Dollygunj, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman Nicobar Islands south andaman - 744103 . 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.

6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidders are advised to carefully go through all the Terms and Conditions stipulated in the bid document. 1. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Outsource in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (beside s PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of THE PRINCIPA L GOVT ITI DOLLYGUNJ SRI VIJAYA PURAM SOUTH ANDAMAN DISTRICT A & N ISLANDS A/C (Name of the Sel ler). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sancti on of the pledgee. For release of Outsource Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Bu yer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 10 days from award of the co ntract offer failing to which the contract offer shall be rewarded to the next L1 firm. 2. No Extension will be given; hence successful bidder is advised to plan the delivery well in advance. If the goods/items/materials are not received within the prescribed date the contract will be deemed cancelled a nd the PG will be forfeited. 3. No extension requests on ground of raising bill on gem portal will be entertained. 4. Rates quoted must be inclusive of all Taxes including GST, cess etc. 5. The goods/items/materials should be in good condition. Any repair if required shall be borne by the succe ssful bidder. 6. Fuel/Petrol shall be provided by the successful bidder. 7. The vehicle shall be used for training purpose, hence additional clutch and break should be installed / com missioned in the vehicle. 8. The vehicle provided shall be free of any ‘Driver’, further the vehicle shall rest in the custody of th e institute for the complete period of contract. 9. The vehicle should fulfil all parameters necessary for Driving Test. 10. The fitness & PUC of the vehicle should be valid upto completion of contract period. 11. Documents to be submitted by the bidders: - a. Registration Certificate of firm/company. b. PAN Card. c. GST Registration No. d. Registration Certificate of Vehicle. e. Valid Permit of Vehicle. .
